facts.value: Arizona State University’s online Master of Science in addiction psychology equips you to provide counseling and treatment to those struggling with addiction issues. In this program, you’ll learn how to provide counseling services, oversee clinical programs and execute case management. Upon graduation, you’ll have the experience and knowledge to pursue licensure and become a practicing counselor.
